name: a receipt in a currency other than spendCurrency is a mismatch; the claim names its own currency first
notes: Grant: ceiling 5000 USD. The shipped policy (receiptMerchants []) caps purchase coverage at partial, but over-scope rules come before every coverage rule (§6.2), so the cap does not matter here. One gmail.receipt entry (acct-a) saw [09:00, 15:00] and synced 15:00 = evaluatedAt.
Purchase claims with an amount and a counterparty, no subject: applicable timeProximity 2500, amountExact 2500, merchantMatch 2000; Σw = 7000.
c1 'acme' 3000 USD (10:02) × o1 receipt 'Acme' 3000 EUR (10:02): tp 1; amountExact 0 (USD ≠ EUR); merchantMatch 1 → S = 4500/7000 = 9/14 ≥ 1/2 → assigned.

c1 amountAboveCeiling (§6.1 v1.3): Amount = the claim's 3000 (in spendCurrency, so it counts); the candidate's EUR amount does not count → 3000 ≤ 5000, not exceeded. The claim's own currency is USD = spendCurrency, but the assigned candidate's currency EUR is present and ≠ USD, whatever the claim's currency → true, reason ceiling.currency_mismatch alone → rule over_ceiling. v1.2 read literally raised nothing here (its candidate clause needed a claim without a currency). It depended on the candidate → finalises like PARTIAL: graceElapsed (15:00 ≥ end(10:03) + 45) → FINAL. Params (§15 v1.4): currency is the claim's when present and ≠ spendCurrency, else the assigned candidate's → {currency: EUR, spendCurrency: USD}.
c2 'acme' 8000 with no currency (12:02) × o2 receipt 'Acme' 8000 CAD (12:02): tp 1; amountExact 0 (the claim has no currency); merchantMatch 1 → 9/14 → assigned.

c2 amountAboveCeiling: Amount = the claim's 8000 (no currency, so it counts; the candidate's CAD amount does not) > 5000 → ceiling.exceeded {amountCents 8000, ceilingCents 5000}; and the candidate's CAD ≠ USD → ceiling.currency_mismatch {currency CAD (the claim has none, so the candidate's), spendCurrency USD}. The mismatch replaces ceiling.exceeded unless the Amount also exceeds the ceiling, which it does → both, in table order → rule over_ceiling. FINAL: graceElapsed (15:00 ≥ end(12:03) + 45), so the reading of finality (claim-only amount, or the candidate's currency) does not matter.

c3 'acme' 3000 EUR (13:02) × o3 receipt 'Acme' 3000 CAD (13:02): tp 1; amountExact 0 (EUR ≠ CAD); merchantMatch 1 → S = 4500/7000 = 9/14 ≥ 1/2 → assigned. amountAboveCeiling: an amount is known (the claim's, in any currency), but neither counts toward the Amount (the claim's EUR and the candidate's CAD are both ≠ USD) → not exceeded; the claim's currency EUR is present and ≠ USD (and so is the candidate's CAD) → true, reason ceiling.currency_mismatch alone → rule over_ceiling. Params (§15 v1.4): the claim's currency when present and ≠ spendCurrency, else the candidate's → {currency: EUR, spendCurrency: USD}, never CAD. The claim's own currency decides it (claim-only, §8) → FINAL at once; graceElapsed holds too (15:00 ≥ end(13:03) + 45). priorSpendCents is not read: over_ceiling matches first.
o1 is outside the windows of c2 [12:00, 12:48] and c3 [13:00, 13:48]; o2 outside those of c1 [10:00, 10:48] and c3; o3 outside those of c1 and c2.
